jobs.occupation: PhD Student in iPSC Disease Modeling and Gene Therapies (f/m/d) (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: The Stem Cell Unit (https://umg.eu/scu) is dedicated to advancing precision medicine by applying patient-specific induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) disease models. We generate and utilize iPSCs for cutting-edge research in genome editing, cardiac differentiation, tissue engineering, and disease modeling. By combining iPSC technology with CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing and state-of-the-art molecular and functional approaches, we investigate the pathophysiology of cardiomyocytes at genomic, omics, functional, and pharmacological levels. Our ultimate goal is to uncover novel mechanisms driving cardiomyopathy and heart failure and to translate these insights into personalized therapeutics and innovative gene therapies. We are seeking a highly motivated PhD student who is eager to work at the interdisciplinary interface between basic research and translational medicine. In this role, you will establish advanced iPSC-based cardiac models and apply them in imaging-driven and functional high-throughput screening assays to identify novel therapeutic strategies.Your tasks- you will develop 2D and cardiac organoid models based on human iPSCs to study cardiovascular diseases- you will use CRISPR/Cas9 for the targeted genetic modification of iPSCs- you will produce AAV vectors for preclinical testing- you will establish suitable screening methods for imaging-based analysis- you will apply preclinical compound screenings and test AAV-based gene strategies to identify novel therapeuticsYour qualifications- university degree (Master or equivalent) in disciplines or fields related to biology, pharmacology or biochemistry- strong interest in stem cell research, genome editing, gene therapies, and cardiovascular medicine- first hands-on experiences in human iPSC culture, CRISPR/Cas technology, and general molecular biology- excellent written and spoken English; German is not required but considered an advantageWe offer- access to state-of-the-art infrastructure for stem cell research, genome editing, advanced imaging, and multi-omics analyses- an inspiring, interdisciplinary, and international research environment with strong translational focus- close collaboration with clinical and basic science groups within the University Medical Center Göttingen, Fraunhofer, and national/international consortia, as well as participation in the German Centers for Health Research (DZHK, DZNE, DZKJ)- an attractive research location in Göttingen, a vibrant hub of biomedical and cardiovascular research in Germany- support for career development, including mentoring, grant writing, leadership training, and opportunities to present at international conferences- a family-friendly workplace with flexible working hours

 - You are responsible for the maintenance of electrical and mechanical systems - Your tasks will also include carrying out inspections, repairs and replacing turbine components - You will always keep health and safety regulations in mind - By taking part in regular, job-related training courses, you continuously expand your knowledge Your profile – what makes you a great fit! Deine Vorteile – weil dein Einsatz zählt! -  Sicherheit & Perspektive: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit langfristiger Perspektive, sowie ein 14/14-Rotationsmodell für planbare Einsätze und echte Erholungsphasen - Weiterentwicklung & Know-how: Intensive Einarbeitung und regelmäßige Trainings sowie fachliche Schulungen an der Vestas Academy, inklusive Qualifikation zur Elektrofachkraft (DIN VDE 0105-100) - Arbeiten & Leben Offshore: Hochwertige Ausrüstung, eine moderne Unterkunft auf einem SOV mit Fitnessstudio, Kino und Gaming-Zone sowie Vollverpflegung während deiner Offshore-Schichten - Technologie & Verantwortung: Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit modernster Windenergietechnologie, innovativen Lösungen und Raum für Ideen - Work-Life-Balance: 20 Urlaubstage während der Offshore-Einsatzzeiten und 22 Urlaubstage in einsatzfreien Zeiträumen sowie Option auf Sabbatical - Attraktive Extras: Business Bike, Fitnessstudio Zuschuss, betriebliche Altersvorsorge - Team & Kultur: Offene, respektvolle Kultur, in der Menschlichkeit und Vielfalt zählen und ein starkes Miteinander in einem internationalen Umfeld  Deine Aufgaben – hier packst du mit an! - Du bist für die Wartung elektrischer und mechanischer Systeme verantwortlich - Zu deinen Aufgaben gehört außerdem die Durchführung von Inspektionen, Reparaturen und der Austausch von Turbinenkomponenten - Dabei hast du stehts die Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsvorschriften im Blick - Durch die Teilnahme an regelmäßigen arbeitsbezogenen Schulungen erweiterst du dein Wissen Dein Profil – damit überzeugst du uns! - Du hast eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder in einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet (EKF) - Hauptsprache im Offshore Bereich ist Englisch. Daher bringst du sehr gute Englischkenntnisse mit - Mit elektrischen und mechanischen Systemen kennst du dich aus – am besten aus praktischer Erfahrung - Du arbeitest sicher an Mittel- oder Hochspannungssystemen - Erfahrung in der Windenergie oder Offshore-Branche ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss - Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsbewusstsein mit und bist bereit in großen Höhen und Offshore zu arbeiten - Du hast Grundkenntnisse in Microsoft Office ___________________________________________________________________________________________________________Unser Engagement für eine faire Einstellung – damit deine Stärken zählenBei Vestas zählt, was wirklich wichtig ist: deine berufliche Erfahrung, deine Ausbildung und deine Fähigkeiten. Damit wir uns ganz auf dein Potenzial konzentrieren können, entferne bitte vor dem Hochladen deines Lebenslaufs alle Fotos, Geburtsdatum, Abschlussjahre, Pronomen, Familienstand und andere persönliche Angaben, die für die Stelle nicht relevant sind. Dein Lebenslauf sollte sich auf deinen beruflichen Werdegang, deine Ausbildung und deine Kontaktdaten (E-Mail und Telefonnummer) konzentrieren. Wir sorgen für einen fairen Prozess: Unsere Hiring-Teams sind in inklusiver Bewertung geschult und wir überprüfen regelmäßig unsere Verfahren, damit deine Qualifikationen im Mittelpunkt stehen.DEIB-ErklärungBei Vestas sind wir überzeugt, dass Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion entscheidend für Innovation und Erfolg sind. Wir heißen alle Menschen willkommen, unabhängig von Hintergrund, Identität oder Lebensweg – und ermutigen besonders diejenigen, die vielleicht zögern, sich zu bewerben.Wie unser CEO, Henrik Andersen, sagt: „Expertise und Talent kommen in vielen Formen. Ein vielfältiges Arbeitsumfeld ermöglicht es uns, anders zu denken und die komplexen Herausforderungen unserer Branche zu meistern“. Deine Perspektive macht den Unterschied: Hilf uns, eine nachhaltige, grüne Energiezukunft voranzutreiben.

jobs.occupation: Project Engineer (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: VetterTec is an innovative company headquartered in Kassel, Germany, with more than 95 years of experience in the development and manufacturing of machinery and systems for industrial drying and dewatering, particularly for the food processing industry. With a team of more than 160 employees across six locations and an international sales share exceeding 80%, we offer an exciting and dynamic working environment.To support our continued growth, we are looking for a Project Engineer who is passionate about driving technically demanding projects to success.As a Project Engineer, you take ownership of projects from kick-off through final handover, both technically and organizationally. Acting as the customer's main point of contact, you work closely with Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, and site teams to ensure successful project execution. This role is ideal for someone who leads through technical expertise and practical experience, with a strong focus on technical project responsibility rather than pure project coordination.Your Responsibilities:- Full project ownership from order handover to technical and commercial handover (TOC) - budget, schedule, risk and scope- Single point of contact for the customer throughout the project- Functional leadership of the core project team - holding the team's capacity together and keeping the project moving as one- Technical judgment: understanding the equipment and the process well enough to challenge assumptions and demand the right decisions at the right time- On-site presence at the milestones that matter — project kick-off, construction start, mechanical and electrical completion, commissioning start, and the final performance run (Leistungsfahrt) through handover- Presence at key suppliers for the acceptance (FAT) of critical components- Running the team's agile rhythm - weekly syncs, a shared task board, rolling short-term planning, and visualizing progress - and adjusting quickly when the project needs it- Integrating the contributions of Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Installation and Commissioning into one coherent project, without replacing any of themWhat You Bring:- Professional experience in international plant or equipment engineering (Anlagenbau), ideally with process or industrial equipment- A hands-on, practical mindset — someone who has stood on a shop floor or a construction site, not only in front of a screen; we weigh practical experience over theoretical credentials- A mechanical engineering background as a Techniker (completed apprenticeship plus Techniker) or a comparable practical qualification (Bachelor's / FH degree)- Experience in vessel and plant construction (Anlagen- und Behälterbau) - manufacturing methods and welding processes- Project management capability - comfortable owning budget, schedule and risk - with a technical center of gravity- Business-fluent English (must-have); German is a plus, not a requirement- Willingness to travel internationally, including assignments of around two weeks at a time- Comfortable leading a team with lightweight agile practices - task boards, short review cycles, rolling planning - rather than heavyweight process- Professional or Senior level - we are hiring at bothHow We Work:- Projects follow a clear phase structure, but day to day we work in short cycles — weekly team syncs, a shared task board, and rolling four-to-six-week planning alongside the overall schedule- Remote work is possible for this role, with on-site presence expected for supplier acceptances of key components and for construction and site activities- You don't need to be based in Germany- Onboarding starts in the office; afterwards, your working pattern is by arrangement- A relaxed, direct working atmosphere — we'd rather solve a problem in the team meeting than escalate itWhat We Offer:- Real ownership of international projects from kick-off through commissioning and final handover- A technically challenging role with a high level of responsibility and the opportunity to shape Project Engineering at VetterTec- A collaborative, solution-oriented culture with short decision-making processes- 30 days of annual leave, attractive working conditions, and a competitive compensation package- Comprehensive employee benefits, including bike leasing, subsidized public transportation, Corporate Benefits, and additional company benefits- Extensive personal and professional development opportunities in an international environment﻿Please don't spend time writing a cover letter. jobs.occupation: Sales Enablement Lead Hybrids (m/f/d) (Berater/in - Erneuerbare Energien)
jobs.description: ENERCON GmbHAt ENERCON, we are combining wind energy and battery storage into integrated hybrid energy systems. To scale our Wind+Storage business, we are looking for a Sales Enablement Lead who can turn grid-scale BESS expertise into practical sales tools, consistent proposals, and clear contracting standards.Your Mission:As Sales Enablement Lead Hybrids (m/f/d), you will be the primary interface within the Solution Line Hybrids for the Head of Technical Sales, who has overall responsibility for Wind+Storage sales. Together, you will establish the sales process from opportunity qualification and initial BESS sizing through proposal development and contracting. You will build the tools and standards that support this process and define a structured handover from Sales to Project Management.You will work closely with the Global Growth Lead within the Solution Line Hybrids to match pipeline projects with suitable contractors and suppliers. While the Global Growth Lead acts as the primary interface to Global Procurement, you will bring customer requirements and proposed offer commitments into the matching process. Together, you will ensure that what ENERCON offers customers aligns with what Global Procurement can source and suppliers can deliver.Your Responsibilities:- Establish and continuously improve the Wind+Storage sales process together with the Head of Technical Sales, defining clear roles, review steps, and deliverables from opportunity qualification through contracting.- Build and maintain technical sales tools for preliminary BESS sizing and configuration, proposal development, and documentation of assumptions and scope boundaries.- Develop standard contract templates and technical schedules with the Head of Technical Sales, Legal, and Engineering, covering scope, performance guarantees, acceptance criteria, and Divisions of Responsibility (DoRs).- Equip regional wind sales teams to qualify and develop standard Wind+Storage opportunities through practical training, playbooks, qualification checklists, and reusable proposal materials.- Define clear criteria with the Head of Technical Sales for when regional teams can proceed independently and when specialist input is needed. Support complex opportunities that require expert review of BESS configurations, customer requirements, or proposed contract commitments.- Partner with the Global Growth Lead on project-to-supplier matching. Bring customer requirements, sizing assumptions, and proposed contract commitments into the assessment so that offers reflect the scope, interfaces, performance, and delivery timelines suppliers can commit to.- Define a structured handover to Project Management so that the agreed technical scope, contractual commitments, assumptions, interfaces, and open risks are documented and transferred at contract award.- Use feedback from regional teams, bids, negotiations, and project handovers to improve sales processes, tools, and contracting standards.Your Profile:- Several years of hands-on experience with grid-scale BESS, including technical sizing and configuration for customer projects. You understand how use cases, grid connection limits, and operating requirements translate into power and energy ratings and performance requirements.- Practical experience in technical sales and contracting for grid-scale BESS projects, including proposal development, scope definition, and negotiation of technical or commercial contract terms.- Familiarity with BESS performance guarantees, acceptance criteria, and Divisions of Responsibility (DoRs), and the ability to translate technical assumptions into clear offer and contract language.- University degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Business Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a comparable field.- Experience building repeatable sales processes, technical sales tools, or standard proposal and contract documentation for complex energy or infrastructure projects.- Experience equipping regional sales teams to sell complex technical solutions, for example through training, practical tools, or coaching on customer opportunities.- Ability to work across Sales, Engineering, Procurement, Legal, and Project Management, and to explain technical trade-offs clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.- Fluent in English; German language skills are an advantage.- Willingness to travel internationally.What Makes This Role Special:You will shape how ENERCON sizes, offers, and contracts Wind+Storage projects. Working alongside the Head of Technical Sales, you will build a sales process that regional wind sales teams can use across markets, giving them more ownership of standard opportunities while allowing Technical Sales to focus its expertise where it adds the most value.By bringing supplier capabilities into the offer process early and making customer commitments clear at handover, you will help ensure that what Sales promises, Procurement sources, and Project Management delivers fit together.Why ENERCON?- Shape the future of renewable energy through innovative Wind+Storage solutions.- Work in a highly international and collaborative environment.- Take ownership of a strategically important global function with high visibility across the organization.- Contribute directly to the growth of sustainable energy systems and the global energy transition.- Join a company with decades of experience and technological leadership in renewable energy.Ready to shape how ENERCON sells and contracts Wind+Storage solutions? We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.description: ENERCON GmbHInnovative ideas are the foundation of our success. At ENERCON, we are driving the energy transition by combining wind energy and battery storage solutions into scalable, sustainable hybrid power systems. closely with the Sales Enablement Lead to match pipeline projects with suitable BESS EPC contractors and system integrators, ensuring that customer offers reflect the scope, responsibilities, and delivery timelines that suppliers can commit to.- Work with Global Procurement and technical teams to evaluate BESS EPC contractors and system integrators, assessing relevant project references, gaps in supplier coverage to support procurement planning and project decisions.- Assess the attractiveness of future markets for Wind+Storage, considering customer demand, market conditions, routes to market, and local supplier and delivery capabilities.- Develop go-to-market plans with regional teams and coordinate market-entry preparations, including identifying local partners and assessing what is needed to deliver the first projects.- Capture lessons from German projects and adapt proven approaches to supplier evaluation, scope definition, and project delivery for new markets.Your in assessing technical and commercial fit, project references, and delivery capability.- Deep understanding of electrical and civil balance of plant (eBoP and cBoP) and practical experience working internationally.What Makes This Role SpecialYou will help determine which partners ENERCON works with to deliver Wind+Storage projects and how responsibilities are shared. By bringing Sales Enablement and Global Procurement together early, you will help ensure that what ENERCON commits to customers is backed by what its suppliers can deliver.As the business expands, you will use lessons from projects in Germany to shape how ENERCON enters new markets. This is a newly established multi-asset offering with a fundamental perspective and a flexible, high-conviction investment approach. It is a hands-on investment role within a team of experienced fund managers with strong investment capabilities.Following a short onboarding period, you will take on responsibility for helping to manage the flagship fund offering, alongside responsibilities in idea generation and client communication. The role is designed to grow towards a deputy position on the flagship offering and eventually take management responsibility for a sister product to the main flagship offering.Alongside core portfolio responsibilities, the platform offers broad opportunities for research across derivatives, cross-asset, fixed income and equities. You will lead a research topic of your own and help drive improvements across the platform.You will join a team with strong views and deep experience, where open debate is part of the daily routine. We are looking for a market-savvy, self-starting colleague who can hold and defend a view when challenged, stays open to being challenged in return, and combines a clear team-player mindset with the initiative to run with the ball.What you will do- Take on day-to-day portfolio management responsibility for the main franchise following a short onboarding, with the aim of becoming deputy portfolio manager of the flagship offering.- Develop a thorough understanding of how the product works and present it with clarity and conviction to clients and distribution partners.- Generate absolute and relative investment ideas for implementation in the portfolio, and contribute to marketing and idea-generation activities.- Bring well-founded investment convictions to the team, challenge team members constructively and welcome being challenged in return.- Lead a research topic across derivatives, cross-asset, fixed income or equities, and drive improvements across the platform.- Collaborate closely across teams as a clear team player, while taking ownership and working independently without the need for constant supervision.What you bring- Relevant experience as a portfolio manager, with evidence of investment judgement and the readiness to assume deputy responsibility for the flagship offering.- Strong quantitative background. Programming skills, in particular AI-enabled programming, are welcome but not essential.- Genuine passion for markets, with the confidence to form a clear view, defend it with evidence under challenge and stand firm within a team with strong views.- Strong understanding of financial markets, with a degree in finance or a related field, or a professional qualification such as the CFA. Derivatives expertise is considered an advantage.- Technical versatility and an interest in applying data and technology to investment decisions.- Strong command of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Familiarity with Bloomberg is required.- Fluent English is required. German is an advantage; proficiency in another European language is an advantage.- Academic excellence combined with a true team-player attitude and a self-starting, proactive way of working.- Experience with Data Analytics.What we offer- We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours)- Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans- Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)- Company share purchasing plan- Mental health and wellbeing programs- Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)- Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group- Self-guided learning & development- … and so much more!
